findings.text: the proved-dead arm retires a promoted run's pointer on a dead pid alone, without the workspace and journal checks release_merged_promotions and retire_promoted_pointer apply, so a promoted run whose worker died leaving uncommitted work in its worktree loses the pointer that keeps that work held; tests/test_a_promoted_run_with_no_live_worker_gives_up_its_pointer.py fails at head 125dc5f on the `dirty` case (assert runs.pointer_path('r-dirty').exists(), line 230) with 1 failed, 16 passed, where the same file passes at the base (1 passed)

_short_host re-implements the host-shortening that reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py:299 _short_hostname owns, whose docstring states the one spelling of the split lives there, and that reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:408 _hosts_match already composes; the host comparison should extend that owner rather than fork a third spelling

the new call passes only only_run, dropping the project and session filters retire_promoted_pointers applies at reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:533-538, so a station tick scoped to one project retires live pointers belonging to every project and session on the workstation

_is_a_promoted_pointer treats the existence of a pending-landing journal as proof the run was promoted, but write_pending at line 325 writes that journal before the promotion completes, so a worker that died mid-promotion has its pointer retired under the same pass that finish_pending_landings at line 1563 uses the live pointer to drive its interrupted-landing retry

item_verdicts.call_sites: retire_promoted_pointers is reached from reckon/crew/station.py:461 on every station tick and from reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:1497 and :1840 inside finish_pending_landings
item_verdicts.diff: read all four commits against d24fa090 (83047227cc, 39bdbefcca, a62c88a164, 125dc5f719); they add one release pass, two liveness readings, one test file and one evidence fragment, and nothing else
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when at docs/plans/a-claim-nobody-is-working-is-released.html:49 requires three fixture runs, two further passes, a base-revision negative control and no added failures in the existing release tests; the gate recorded in the manifest covers all but the last, and that last check is false at the delivered head
item_verdicts.goal: plan section s2's deliverable at docs/plans/a-claim-nobody-is-working-is-released.html:48 is a promoted run whose launcher host is not the fleet node and which shows no turn giving up its pointer; reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:543 does that and calls it from retire_promoted_pointers at line 634
item_verdicts.manifest: the reviewed manifest.md records tests, test_logs, both suite arms with completed true and 0 failure ids, and a negative-control.log with EXIT=1 and 2 failed ids; its changed_paths line lists three of the four delivered paths and omits the evidence fragment
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed node declared reckon/crew/pending_landing.py, reckon/crew/process_liveness.py, reckon/crew/promotion_release.py, tests/test_a_run_from_a_previous_fleet_node_is_released.py and a plan evidence fragment and figure directory; the diff touches four paths, all at or inside those, and promotion_release.py was not needed

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_run_from_a_previous_fleet_node_is_released.py:118 fails if release_pointers_of_a_previous_fleet_node is removed (the recorded negative control shows 2 failed at base), but no added assertion guards the dead-on-this-node arm's interaction with the existing uncommitted-work hold at reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:583.
justifications.evidence: the gate recorded in the reviewed manifest runs tests/test_a_run_from_a_previous_fleet_node_is_released.py, tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, but the done_when at docs/plans/a-claim-nobody-is-working-is-released.html:49 also requires the existing release tests to add no failure, and the release test reckons/crew/pending_landing.py's change reaches was never run.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/process_liveness.py:552 and reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:543 follow the module's lazy-import, Mapping-typed, mechanism-named idiom and carry no plan or ticket labels.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:543 implements plan section s2's deliverable (docs/plans/a-claim-nobody-is-working-is-released.html:48): a promoted pointer whose launcher host is not the fleet record's node and whose stream shows no turn is retired.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/process_liveness.py:586 adds _short_host, re-implementing the host shortening that reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py:299 _short_hostname owns and reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:408 _hosts_match composes, instead of reusing that owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the four-commit diff (reckon/crew/pending_landing.py, reckon/crew/process_liveness.py, tests/test_a_run_from_a_previous_fleet_node_is_released.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-claim-nobody-is-working-is-released/acniw-a-run-whose-worker-was-on-a-previous-fleet-node-gives-up.html) is inside the declared write paths.
